summary: Skill Studio Phase 1 (Docs track) end-to-end testing. Backend 25/25 new tests + 50/51 regression pass (1 pre-existing flake in test_new_features.py, unrelated to Studio). Frontend: hub, mission runner live-ticking, submit/grade dialog, PDF export, capstone 150pts, nav-studio, quest launch-lab all working. THREE bugs found: (1) CRITICAL UI — color popover has 0-width columns causing all 6 swatches to overlap in a 36px stack (users cannot reliably pick blue/red/green/etc); (2) BACKEND — studio_progress.grade is overwritten unconditionally on any resubmit even if score is lower, so a mastered mission that a student later tinkers with shows F on the hub card while still counted as mastered; (3) CONTENT — docs-m3 tasks t2 (all lines 12pt) and t3 (title 24pt) are mutually exclusive; impossible to score above 67% D.

minor.issue: server.py L493 stores 'grade': grade unconditionally on resubmit while 'score' uses max(). After a partial resubmit on a previously-A/mastered mission, the stored/persisted grade drops (e.g. A -> F) even though score, points_earned, and mastery correctly stick to best-attempt. Hub card renders the stale grade (see docs-m2 rendered 'F' with green mastery check in screenshot). Fix: 'grade': prev.get('grade', grade) if prev and prev.get('score', 0) >= score else grade — OR letter_grade(new_stored_score).

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: the color-swatch popover container has no explicit width. It renders at width=36px, splitting into three ~0.67px-wide grid columns (grid-cols-3), which causes all 6 color buttons to stack visually on top of each other (only the bottom-most swatch — purple — is clickable via visible pixels). Users cannot reliably pick blue, red, green, orange, or black. Confirmed via getComputedStyle: gridTemplateColumns='0.65625px 0.671875px 0.671875px'. The symbol popover works because it has explicit w-48. Fix: add w-32 (or similar) to the color popover div in /app/frontend/src/components/studio/DocEditorCore.jsx L116.

issues: docs-m2 card shows stored grade 'F' next to a green mastery check after any partial resubmit (backend grade overwrite bug surfaces here)

action_items: Fix CRITICAL: add explicit width (e.g. `w-32`) to color popover in /app/frontend/src/components/studio/DocEditorCore.jsx line 116. Without this, the text-color feature is essentially unusable — users can only click the last color rendered (purple). Verify by opening docs-m4 → click studio-color → all 6 swatches should render side-by-side in 2 rows of 3, each fully clickable.

Fix BACKEND: in /app/backend/server.py L493, do NOT unconditionally overwrite the stored 'grade' on resubmit. Either derive grade from the max stored score, or only write grade when score >= prev.score. Currently a mastered A can be visually demoted to F on the hub if the student resubmits a partial doc.

Fix CONTENT (docs-m3): the mission is impossible to complete perfectly. t2 (fmt_all fontSize=12) and t3 (b1 fontSize=24) contradict each other. Either drop t3, or change t2 to fmt_multi on body blocks only (b2, b3), or change the equals value. Currently every student who follows the instructions gets D (67%) as their best.
Optional: colocate reused popover width classes / verify the whole color palette is visible in a screenshot test to prevent regression.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L493: 'grade' persisted unconditionally on resubmit; should follow best-attempt like 'score' and 'points_earned' do (L493 already uses max()).

DocEditorCore.jsx L116: color popover has no explicit width class — relies on button intrinsic width but grid-cols-3 collapses columns to ~0.6px when parent is 36px. Compare to symbol popover L147 which correctly uses w-48.
skillstudio.py DOCS_MISSIONS[2] (docs-m3): tasks t2 fmt_all fontSize=12 and t3 fmt b1 fontSize=24 are logically contradictory; unwinnable mission.

server.py studio_submit (L471–515): endpoint returns response 'mastery' equal to CURRENT submit's mastery (not sticky). UI/dialog will show 'Reach 90% for mastery' after a partial resubmit of a previously-mastered mission, which is misleading. Consider returning sticky mastery in the response so the dialog matches persisted state.
DocEditorCore.jsx: the parent page div's onClick={()=>setMenu(null)} works, but does not close the popover on Escape key — minor a11y nit.

skillstudio.py: no per-mission bounds checks on submit doc payload — server trusts any doc shape. Non-security issue but worth adding a Pydantic schema for the doc structure to catch malformed submissions early.

success_rate.backend: 100% (25/25 new + 50/51 regression, with 1 pre-existing flake unrelated to Studio)
success_rate.frontend: Studio primary flows 100%; discovered 1 critical UI bug (color popover overlap) and 1 backend-surfaced design issue (grade-overwrite renders wrong badge on hub)

context_for_next_testing_agent: New backend suite /app/backend/tests/test_skillstudio.py covers every check kind in skillstudio.grade_mission plus best-attempt / RBAC / points events. It documents the docs-m3 impossibility (test_420) and the grade-overwrite behavior (test_310, test_910) — if the main agent fixes either, update the corresponding assertions. Frontend cookie injection works reliably on the preview host (SameSite=None, secure, httpOnly). For the color-popover fix verification, take a screenshot of the popover after clicking studio-color and assert all 6 swatches are visible side-by-side (no overlap). Playwright's coordinate-click hit the wrong swatch until the width bug is fixed — using page.evaluate + element.click() bypasses this. AI Copilot streaming and expedition flows are untouched by this iteration.

color_popover_overlap.root_cause: The color popover <div className='absolute z-30 top-11 left-0 ... grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 shadow-xl'> has no explicit width. Its intrinsic width comes from the parent .relative wrapper (about 36px wide, the width of the studio-color toolbar button). grid-cols-3 then divides those 36px into three ~0.67px columns, and each w-7 button (28px) overflows its cell — since they're all in the same visual stack, the last one (purple) covers the rest.
color_popover_overlap.reproduction: Load /studio/docs/docs-m4 → click studio-block-b1 → click studio-color. Popover appears width=36px. Inspect gridTemplateColumns via devtools: '0.65625px 0.671875px 0.671875px'. Click any specific-color swatch — the click always lands on purple (top of stack) despite the coordinate matching an underlying swatch's rect.
color_popover_overlap.fix: In /app/frontend/src/components/studio/DocEditorCore.jsx line 116, add an explicit width to the popover, e.g. change className to include 'w-32' (128px). Verified against symbol popover on line 147 which uses w-48 and renders correctly.

grade_overwrite.root_cause: server.py studio_submit (line ~493) writes 'grade': grade — the current submit's grade — unconditionally, while 'score' uses max(score, prev['score']) and 'points_earned' uses max(). If a student earns A on m2, then reopens the mission and clicks around/resubmits with a partial doc, the stored grade is overwritten with the current lower grade even though score and mastery remain best-attempt.
grade_overwrite.reproduction: POST /api/studio/docs/docs-m2/submit with a perfect doc -> stored grade=A, score=100, mastery=True. POST again with only 1/3 tasks -> stored grade=F, score=100, mastery=True (mismatch). Hub card renders the stale F.
grade_overwrite.fix: Only overwrite grade when new score >= prev score, i.e. store letter_grade(max(score, prev['score'])). Or leave 'grade' out of the resubmit patch when score < prev['score'].

docs_m3_impossible.root_cause: Task t2 (fmt_all fontSize=12) requires EVERY block including b1 to be 12pt. Task t3 (fmt b1 fontSize=24) requires b1 to be 24pt. These are mutually exclusive.
docs_m3_impossible.reproduction: GET /api/studio/docs → docs-m3.tasks. Apply the instruction faithfully and submit — best achievable score is 67% (D).
docs_m3_impossible.fix: Change t2 kind to 'fmt_multi' targeting body blocks only (['b2','b3']), or increase t3 to a non-conflicting attribute, or drop t3.
